caption: The drawing depicts four rectangular swatches of patterned fabric arranged in a two-by-two grid on a plain background. The upper left swatch has a dark olive-green background with a floral pattern featuring cream, red, and tan flowers with green leaves. The upper right swatch is purple with light purple leafy branches and small white flowers dispersed throughout. The lower left swatch is maroon with a subtle floral and leafy design in a slightly lighter shade of maroon, accented by small white dots. The lower right swatch is tan with an outlined pattern of large leaves and small green dots, accented by dotted and dashed lines in brown. Handwritten text appears below and near the lower right swatch, reading "Mary C. Davidson," and there are other handwritten notations in pencil and red ink in the lower left margin area.
title: Printed Swatches
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
